name: Fresno

neighborhoods.name: Tower District
neighborhoods.homes: 1920s–30s bungalows, duplexes and small apartment buildings

neighborhoods.name: Fig Garden
neighborhoods.homes: older ranch houses on larger lots

housing: Fresno renters mostly live in single-family ranch houses and two-story apartment complexes, with older bungalows in the Tower District.

localRules.text: Fresno's Rental Housing Improvement Program requires every residential rental property to be registered with the city, and properties get a baseline inspection followed by routine inspections.

tenantHelp.name: Central California Legal Services
tenantHelp.what: free civil legal help for low-income renters

climate: Summer highs often pass 100°F, so test the air conditioning, check window screens, and note any dust or smoke getting in through gaps.
fact: Anyone can look up whether a Fresno rental is on the city's registry by its street address.
